name: plan_work
description: Write the plan for this task as a short checklist the person sees, replacing any earlier plan. Use it when the work has three or more steps or the person asked for several things; not for a question or a one-step change. One action per item, in order, at most 50, each under 200 characters. Then mark progress with plan_check (one item `doing` at a time, `done` as soon as it is) and add what you discover with plan_add. Every call returns the whole plan; plan_check with no arguments shows it again. Example: {"title":"Fix the date parser","items":["Reproduce the failing test","Fix parse_date for time zones","Run the checks","Open the pull request"]}

title.description: A short name for the plan

items.description: The items, in order, one action each
